name: ai-agent-framework-mvp-v0.7-agents
description: Reusable agent-agnostic software engineering framework with multi-tool installation support, adaptive self-evolution, orchestration capability probing and fallback levels, MCP tool discovery and self-installation, Python-based validation tooling, evidence-based quality gates, a machine-readable control plane (framework.config.yaml), an autonomy dial with operational safety rules, token/model optimization, knowledge-base indexing, capability model aliases, KB auditing, and lightweight Saarthi observability logging.
notes: AGENTS.md enables repo-level instructions for all tools that can read repository files (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Continue, Antigravity, and others).
saarthi.agent.md is the tool-agnostic custom agent configuration; it auto-resolves framework home across VS Code, Cursor, Claude Code, and more.

framework.config.yaml is the machine-readable source of truth for modes, orchestration levels, model tiers, budgets, Definition of Done, safety rules, adaptive learning thresholds, MCP server configuration, capability aliases, and Saarthi observability settings.
_framework/INDEX.md routes each decision to its canonical source and lists the always-on minimal core.
_framework/16-adaptive-learning.md governs self-evolution: learning user preferences, when to apply them silently vs confirm, and how to persist them in knowledge-base/preferences/.
_framework/17-mcp-tool-discovery.md governs MCP gap detection, registry research, recommendation, and self-installation with user confirmation.
_framework/18-saarthi-observability.md defines the lightweight per-work-item debug log of Saarthi's own decisions (mode classification, preferences applied, gates, budget alarms).
models.capability_aliases maps human-readable names (fast/standard/reasoning/expert) to tier keys for use in prose and agent instructions.
tools/audit_kb.py audits the knowledge-base for orphaned files, dead INDEX links, stale preferences, and missing front-matter.
tools/run_capability_probe.py scores the current model across capability dimensions and recommends an orchestration level.
Provide Work Item ID in prompt to create/resume work-items/<WORK_ITEM_ID>/.
Strict Mode is default; Prototype Mode only when explicitly requested.
Verification commands are auto-discovered once per work item and cached in work-items/<ID>/verification-commands.yaml; not hard-coded.
Every 'done' claim must be backed by pasted build/test/lint evidence (see _framework/13).
Before closing a work item, run: python tools/validate_work_item.py <WORK_ITEM_ID> --root .
Run framework health checks with: python tools/smoke_test_framework.py --root . and python tools/validate_framework.py --root .
Audit the knowledge base with: python tools/audit_kb.py --root .
Run a capability probe with: python tools/run_capability_probe.py --root .
Pick an autonomy level (L1/L2/L3) and record assumptions in the decision register (see _framework/14).
Use work-item-summary.md as compressed memory; load the knowledge base via knowledge-base/INDEX.md.
Create only artifacts required by workflow mode.
Use model selection and token optimization policies to reduce AI cost without reducing engineering discipline.
